about: The long run. Batch B-4471 of DEMO-7 fire alarm panels, 2,400 panels, 40 parties over 10 simulated days: 5 on the shipment records, 21 installers found in the distributors' order systems, 14 named by forwarders (12 building owners, one more installer and Corner Properties). 36 are simulated parties with behaviour profiles; Harbour Fire and Corner Properties answer real phones in the demo. Every building owner's panels are installed at first and fixed two to four simulated days in. Ends with only the slice's panels open (15 disputed, 25 installed and not fixed at Corner Properties), so the recall cannot close.

recall.hazard: The sounder circuit may fail to activate in an alarm
